subtitle: Lesson 19 · Hosting the Off-Chain Stack

caption: Unlike a static frontend, an indexer is a long-running process that must stay up.
Start from a pinned, published image -- not a hand-built one nobody can reproduce.

eyebrow: Scanning the image before it ships
caption: A base image with unpatched CVEs is an attack surface, same as unaudited contract code.

code:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
USER node
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
caption: Pinned base image, locked dependencies, non-root user -- the same discipline as a pinned Solidity compiler version.
